raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 29
Reason for Mistake: When asked to extract and count pre-2020 works from the ORCID “Works” section, WebSurfer returned a generic biographical summary of Manuela Nagel’s profile instead of the required publication-year data. This failure to access or parse the Works section (likely due to JavaScript-rendered content or using an inappropriate “summarize_page” approach rather than the ORCID API) meant no quantitative data was gathered, directly leading to the inability to compute the average and the incorrect final conclusion.
